records.title: Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Demonstration Using Mixture Density Networks with Sampling-Free Variance Modeling
records.reason: This paper concerns learning robot demonstrations with mixture-density networks; its title states no LLM inference or serving-efficiency contribution.

records.title: SafeArena: Evaluating the Safety of Autonomous Web Agents
records.reason: SafeArena evaluates misuse risks of autonomous web agents; its focus is agent safety and harmful-task behavior, not runtime or inference efficiency.

records.title: CheckEval: A reliable LLM-as-a-Judge framework for evaluating text generation using checklists
records.reason: CheckEval decomposes LLM-as-judge criteria to improve text-generation evaluation reliability; it reports agreement quality rather than evaluation or serving cost.

records.title: PINNsFormer: A Transformer-Based Framework For Physics-Informed Neural Networks
records.reason: This paper applies a Transformer framework to physics-informed neural networks, with no stated LLM inference, serving, or efficiency contribution.

records.title: Graph Mixture of Experts: Learning on Large-Scale Graphs with Explicit Diversity Modeling
records.reason: Graph Mixture of Experts targets diversity and generalization in graph neural networks; this is a graph-learning application, not LLM MoE inference.

records.title: Mind's Eye: Grounded Language Model Reasoning through Simulation
records.reason: Mind’s Eye augments language-model physical reasoning with simulator outputs to improve accuracy; it adds a domain-reasoning capability without claiming execution efficiency.

records.title: AtomMem : Learnable Dynamic Agentic Memory with Atomic Memory Operation
records.reason: AtomMem learns agent memory CRUD policies and improves long-context task performance, but the abstract gives no measured reduction in memory footprint, context tokens, or inference overhead.

records.title: Multiplex Thinking: Reasoning via Token-wise Branch-and-Merge
records.reason: Multiplex Thinking reports shorter reasoning sequences through a soft token that samples K candidate tokens, but the abstract does not establish that the extra per-step sampling lowers total inference compute, latency, or resource use.

records.title: Med-CMR: A Fine-Grained Benchmark Integrating Visual Evidence and Clinical Logic for Medical Complex Multimodal Reasoning
records.reason: This is a medical multimodal-reasoning benchmark, an application evaluation with no stated LLM inference or serving-efficiency method.

records.title: CaptionQA: Is Your Caption as Useful as the Image Itself?
records.reason: This paper presents a caption-and-image question-answering benchmark; the title states no model inference, serving, or efficiency contribution.
